info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Application Migration Service API (2020-02-26). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Applications, waves, connectors and the launch and replication configuration templates are stored configuration: no source server, replication agent, staging area, replication server, job, test or cutover instance exists, nothing replicates, and StartReplication, StartTest, StartCutover, FinalizeCutover, TerminateTargetInstances, imports, exports, every source server, job, vCenter, action and post-launch operation, InitializeService and the other official operations return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. UninitializedAccountException is never returned because no service-linked role is needed. Applications, waves and connectors have no read operation, so they are read through their List operations. The filters member of the List operations is refused instead of being ignored, AssociateApplications and DisassociateApplications are not implemented so waveID and the aggregated status members are never reported, and names are not required to be unique. Archive and Unarchive only set isArchived. Template members that are not supplied are not defaulted, and no EC2 launch template exists, so ec2LaunchTemplateID is never reported. Subnet, security group, KMS key, S3 bucket, IAM and SSM references in templates and connectors are stored as given and never resolved. The ARN forms application/{id}, wave/{id}, connector/{id}, launch-configuration-template/{id} and replication-configuration-template/{id} are the simulator's reading of the authorization reference. At most 50 applications, 50 waves, 20 connectors and 20 templates of each kind exist per Region as local limits.
